home.welcomeText: A place for environmentalists to contribute and support one another in protecting the environment and building a sustainable future. However small, your care for the environment always makes a difference.
home.tagline: Every small act of care makes a difference.
home.nearText: Find reforestation programmes and environmental actions nearby, then join in with other members.
feat1.d: Take part as a volunteer or paid helper in actions near you.
feat2.d: Support the activities you care about. 1 Benih = {price}.
feat3.d: Invite other members and collect Benih for your action.
feat4.d: Volunteer points and donations unlock new badges.
